findings.title: 6-day, ~7-of-11-agent pipeline outage 2026-08-02..2026-08-08 — /sessions device 100% full at host level; agents cloning to ${SESSION}/<agent>-clone all ENOSPC while root FS had ~2.8 GB free
findings.description: Root cause chain: (1) the scheduled-sandbox /sessions device (nvme1n1, 9.98 GB) is at 0 MB available; (2) all ${SESSION}-clone agents (workspace-sync per monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md:dome-sync-clone, dome-mirror per monitor/prompts/dome-mirror.md:dome-mirror-clone, curmudgeon per monitor/prompts/curmudgeon.md:dome-curmudgeon-clone, tinker per monitor/prompts/tinker.md:tinker-clone, curmudgeon-verify per monitor/prompts/curmudgeon-verify.md:dome-curmudgeon-verify-clone) fail at clone; (3) gated agents aborted fail-closed (monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-abort-2026-08-08T14-53-33Z.json: clone_fs_avail_mb=0, root_fs_avail_mb=2782 — the discriminator proving root-FS headroom existed throughout); (4) ungated agents either went dark (decider: no commit after 'Decider run 2026-08-02T02:15Z', social: none after 'social 2026-08-02') or improvised degraded-FUSE writes (curmudgeon, analyst — see stranded-artifacts finding). The accumulation is host-level: 5,701 session dirs on the device, each unreadable/un-deletable from other sessions' uids; in-sandbox cleanup is impossible. Poller's same-day finding (monitor/changes/chg-20260808-1620-001.json) and integrity's (monitor/integrity/report-2026-08-08T15-25.json issues_found[0]) are the sibling detections; this report adds the clone-target discriminator and the fix path.
findings.evidence: df -m /sessions => 9980 total / 9464 used / 0 avail (this run); ls /sessions | wc -l => 5701; du -sm /sessions (uid-visible only) => 352 MB, i.e. ~9.1 GB is other-session-owned; git clone into /sessions/epic-zen-ramanujan/tinker-clone => 'fatal: could not create work tree dir ... No space left on device' while df -m / => 3180 MB free; git log gap 08-03..08-07 for analyst/curmudgeon/decider/social/workspace-sync/dome-mirror/tinker
findings.recommendation: PROP-148 (authored this run): Part A clone-target fallback to /tmp when sessions-FS < 700 MB; Part B fail-closed disk gates + no-FUSE-improvisation prohibition on the five ungated prompts; Part C OPERATOR/HOST drain of /sessions (the actual root cause — no sandbox workaround); Part D sessions_fs_avail_mb telemetry (shipped this run in queue-history.jsonl).
